entries.speaker: Man Heading to Work
entries.en: Why is it late again? The accident was[n]yesterday.

entries.speaker: Exhausted Station Attendant
entries.en: Our apologies. However, it was a major[n]accident, and—

entries.speaker: Man Heading to Work
entries.en: This isn't the first time this happened.[n]Why weren't you better prepared for[n]this one? Sheesh...

entries.speaker: Man Heading to Work
entries.en: Man, I'm already late. When is it going[n]to start running again?

entries.speaker: Exhausted Station Attendant
entries.en: Our apologies. We are doing everything[n]possible to get the trains running normally[n]again...

entries.speaker: Tired Station Worker
entries.en: Yes, there are still delays affecting the[n]schedule...

entries.speaker: Tired Station Worker
entries.en: Please go toward [clr 2]Exit 8[clr 27] to reach the[n]JL and Ginza Lines.

entries.speaker: Tired Station Worker
entries.en: I can help the next customer...

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Repeated psychotic episodes terrorize[n]the city! What are your thoughts on all[n]of this, sir?

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Some people are saying it's the result[n]of an oppressive work environment.[n]Do you have any comments on that?

entries.speaker: Unreliable Station Attendant
entries.en: I-I'm terribly sorry, I don't know[n]anything! We'll, uh, make an official[n]statement at a later time...

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: I just wanna hear your opinion, sir.[n]Just give me your personal thoughts on it.

entries.speaker: Unreliable Station Attendant
entries.en: B-But I really don't know anything...
